Develop and implement strategic marketing plans to enhance the hotel's brand positioning, visibility, and revenue growth.

d: The Shovel Operator is responsible for operating and driving the loading shovel within the working yard area to ensure all raw materials are moved, stocked, and loaded correctly. The role supports uninterrupted concrete production by ensuring materials are supplied to the correct plant hoppers while maintaining safety, quality, and housekeeping standards.
q: Minimum 1 year of experience as a Shovel Operator / Wheel Loader Operator.
Experience in Readymix, Quarry, Construction, or Industrial operations preferred.
Good understanding of material handling and stockpile management.
Ability to conduct daily inspections and basic maintenance checks.
Strong awareness of health and safety requirements when operating heavy equipment around personnel and vehicles.
Attention to detail and quality control.
Ability to work under pressure and meet production requirements.
r: Operate the loading shovel in accordance with company procedures and manufacturer guidelines.
Safely transport, stockpile, and load aggregates, sand, and other raw materials within the yard.
Feed the correct materials into concrete plant bins and hoppers as instructed by the Batcher and Shipper.
Carry out daily inspections and pre-start checks of the loading shovel and report any defects or maintenance requirements.
Maintain the loading shovel in accordance with company and manufacturer maintenance procedures.
Ensure all materials are stored in the correct bays and bins without contamination, overspill, or wastage.
Assist in maintaining clean, organized, and safe stockyard, loading, and storage areas with support from labourers.
Monitor material levels and notify supervisors of low stock levels.
Follow instructions and perform additional duties as assigned by supervisors and management.
Complete daily operational records and equipment checklists as required.
Understand, comply with, and actively promote the Company's SHE (Safety, Health & Environment) Policy and Golden Goals.
Ensure all activities are carried out in accordance with Health & Safety procedures, risk assessments, and relevant legislation.
Ensure compliance with all PPE requirements and site safety rules by employees, contractors, and visitors.
Report all accidents, near misses, unsafe acts, unsafe conditions, and traffic violations immediately.
Attend toolbox talks, safety meetings, and training sessions as required.
Operate equipment safely in areas where ground personnel and other vehicles are present.
Observe and comply with all site traffic management rules and road safety regulations.
